title: Employ staff under the Silviculture Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Silviculture Award 2020.

sources.title: Silviculture Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This industry award covers employers throughout Australia in the industry of silviculture and afforestation and their employees in the classifications listed in clause 12 — Classifications to the exclusion of any other modern award.

reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Silviculture Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 For the purpose of clause 4 , silviculture and afforestation means planting, pruning, fertilising and any other activity in or in connection with the establishment or cultivation of trees in forests.

assessment.summary: The Silviculture Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
